faq.headline: What you should know before starting a website project.
faq.desc: Common questions about IMPAKT’s service packages, process, pricing, technical delivery, and post-launch support.

questions.question: Does IMPAKT use ready-made templates for website design?
questions.answer: IMPAKT does not follow a generic design approach. The interface is shaped by the brand identity, business goals, and user behavior. Technical libraries may be used to improve development efficiency, but the layout and experience are designed specifically for each project.

questions.question: Should I choose a Personal, Business, or E-commerce website?
questions.answer: A Personal Website is suitable for portfolios, landing pages, or simple introductions. A Business Website fits brands that need multiple pages, content management, and a professional service presentation. E-commerce is designed for stores that need products, carts, orders, and payment features.

questions.question: Can I request features outside the selected package?
questions.answer: Yes. Additional features are assessed for relevance, delivery time, and cost before implementation. The scope is expanded only after both parties agree.

questions.question: What are the main stages of a website project?
questions.answer: A typical process includes requirement discovery, brand research, content structure, interface design, development, testing, launch, and operating guidance. Milestones may be adjusted to match the project scale.

questions.question: What should the client prepare before the project begins?
questions.answer: You should prepare your brand information, logo, existing colors, company introduction, service or product list, images, and reference websites. If some materials are not available, IMPAKT will help identify the most important content first.

questions.question: How long does a website project usually take?
questions.answer: The timeline depends on the number of pages, custom design level, features, and content feedback speed. Personal websites often take 5–10 working days, business websites 10–20 days, and e-commerce websites usually start from 20 working days.

questions.question: How many design revision rounds are included?
questions.answer: The number of feedback rounds is defined in the project scope. Feedback should be consolidated by round to protect the schedule and avoid unnecessary changes. Requests outside the approved direction may be treated as additional work.

questions.question: Are the prices on the service page final?
questions.answer: They are starting prices for a standard scope. The final quotation depends on the number of pages, features, content, customization level, and third-party integrations. IMPAKT confirms the total cost before the project begins.

questions.question: Are domain and hosting costs included?
questions.answer: Domain, hosting, business email, and third-party services are usually quoted separately because the cost depends on the provider and subscription period. IMPAKT can recommend a suitable setup and assist with configuration.

questions.question: How is project payment handled?
questions.answer: Payments are divided by project milestones and stated in the quotation or agreement. The project begins after the first payment is confirmed.

questions.question: Will the website work well on mobile and tablet devices?
questions.answer: Yes. Responsive delivery is a standard part of development. The website is tested across multiple screen sizes to ensure the layout, text, images, and interactions remain usable.

questions.question: Will I receive the source code after completion?
questions.answer: Source-code delivery is confirmed in the selected package and project agreement. For projects that include source delivery, IMPAKT provides the code and basic deployment or operating guidance.

questions.question: Is the website optimized for SEO?
questions.answer: The website includes foundational SEO structure such as page titles, descriptions, headings, URLs, performance, and responsive display. Content SEO, keyword research, and advanced growth campaigns are separate services.

questions.question: Can the website integrate Zalo, maps, forms, and social media?
questions.answer: Yes. Common integrations such as Zalo, hotline, email, Google Maps, contact forms, Facebook, Instagram, and analytics tools can be implemented according to the project requirements.

questions.question: Does IMPAKT provide support after the website is delivered?
questions.answer: Yes. IMPAKT supports technical issues during the stated warranty period. Content updates, new features, or long-term operation can be handled through a separate support package.

questions.question: Can I update the website content myself?
questions.answer: For packages with a content management system, you can update articles, images, services, or products based on the configured permissions. IMPAKT provides basic operating guidance during handover.

questions.question: What happens if the website has a problem later?
questions.answer: You can send the issue details through the support channel. IMPAKT will identify whether the cause comes from the source code, hosting, domain, or a third-party service, then recommend a solution and any applicable cost outside the warranty scope.

privacy.headline: Your privacy is respected in every interaction.
privacy.desc: This policy explains how IMPAKT collects, uses, stores, and protects personal data when you visit the website, submit a form, or discuss a project.
privacy.toc_note: You may contact IMPAKT to request clarification, access, correction, deletion, or other handling of your personal data.

summary.title: Transparency from the start
summary.desc: These principles guide how personal data is handled.

items.title: Collected only when needed
items.desc: Data is limited to consultation, operation, and website improvement purposes.

items.title: Personal data is not sold
items.desc: IMPAKT does not independently trade or exchange personal data for commercial gain.

items.title: You remain in control
items.desc: You may request access, correction, deletion, or restriction where applicable.

sections.title: Introduction and scope of this policy
paragraphs: This privacy policy applies to the website, contact forms, and online channels managed by IMPAKT Studio. By using the website or voluntarily providing information, you acknowledge that you have read this policy.

This policy does not automatically apply to third-party websites, platforms, or services linked from the IMPAKT website. Those parties maintain their own policies and data-processing responsibilities.

sections.title: Personal data that may be collected
paragraphs: Depending on how you interact with the website, IMPAKT may process the following categories of data.
bullets: Identity and contact information you provide, including your name, phone number, and email address.
Project information, such as the website type, objectives, message content, preferred timeline, or estimated budget.
Technical and website-usage information, which may include device type, browser, visited pages, access time, IP address where necessary, and performance data.
Preferences stored on your device, including light or dark appearance, language, and experience settings.
notes: Please do not submit sensitive personal data or unnecessary information through the contact form.

sections.title: How IMPAKT collects data
paragraphs: Data is collected when you voluntarily enter and submit information, contact IMPAKT by email or phone, interact with the website, or use integrated features.
bullets: Through contact forms or consultation requests.
Through published email, phone, and communication channels.
Through browser storage used to remember appearance, language, or interface choices.
Through configured website analytics and operational tools, including Vercel Analytics or an equivalent service.

sections.title: How personal data is used
paragraphs: IMPAKT uses personal data only for the communicated purposes or related legitimate purposes.
bullets: Receive, verify, and respond to consultation requests.
Assess requirements and prepare proposals, quotations, and project scopes.
Communicate, deliver, hand over, and support a project when the parties work together.
Maintain website operation, safety, performance, and user experience.
Fulfill accounting, tax, dispute-resolution, or legal obligations.
Send marketing information where a lawful basis or appropriate consent exists; you may request to stop receiving it.

sections.title: Sharing and disclosure of personal data
paragraphs: IMPAKT does not sell personal data. Data is shared only when necessary to deliver services, operate systems, comply with the law, or protect legitimate rights and interests.
bullets: Infrastructure, hosting, storage, email, form, analytics, or security providers used by the website.
Partners and contractors involved in a project within the necessary scope and subject to appropriate confidentiality duties.
Government authorities or authorized parties where legally required.
Parties involved in a restructuring, transfer of operations, or asset transaction, subject to appropriate safeguards.
notes: IMPAKT limits the data provided to recipients according to a need-to-know principle and a defined purpose.

sections.title: Cookies, browser storage, and website analytics
paragraphs: The website may use cookies, localStorage, or similar technologies to maintain settings, remember appearance and language, protect the system, and measure performance.

The website may currently integrate Vercel Analytics to collect technical and usage statistics according to its configuration. Analytics information is used to understand performance and improve the experience, not to identify users unnecessarily.
bullets: You may manage or delete browser-stored data through your browser settings.
Disabling certain storage technologies may prevent appearance, language, or website features from working as expected.

sections.title: Retention periods and security measures
paragraphs: Data is retained for as long as necessary to complete the processing purpose, maintain a client relationship, resolve requests, or fulfill legal obligations. When no longer required, data is deleted, anonymized, or handled through an appropriate process.
IMPAKT applies reasonable organizational and technical measures to reduce unauthorized access, loss, disclosure, alteration, or destruction.
bullets: Limit access according to roles and work requirements.
Use infrastructure and connections with appropriate security measures.
Monitor and respond to data-security incidents when detected.
Review and update safeguards according to the level of risk.
notes: No storage or transmission method is completely secure. IMPAKT works to apply safeguards appropriate to the nature of the data and activity.

sections.title: Your rights and choices
paragraphs: To the extent permitted by applicable law, you may exercise rights relating to your personal data. IMPAKT may request identity verification before handling a request.
bullets: Receive information and notice about data-processing activities.
Give, refuse, or withdraw consent where processing relies on consent.
Request access, provision, correction, or updating of data.
Request deletion, restriction, or objection where applicable.
Submit complaints, reports, claims, or compensation requests under the law.
Request an explanation or contact the competent authority.
notes: Some requests may be limited where retention or processing is necessary to fulfill legal duties, protect legitimate rights, or resolve disputes.

sections.title: Cross-border processing and transfers
paragraphs: Some infrastructure, hosting, analytics, or technical providers may operate servers or process data outside Vietnam. Where a cross-border transfer occurs, IMPAKT will apply the requirements and safeguards required by current law.
Providers are selected based on operational needs, security considerations, and processing conditions.

sections.title: Children's personal data
paragraphs: IMPAKT's website and services are intended for clients seeking website design and development and are not designed to intentionally collect children's data. If children's data must be processed, IMPAKT will follow applicable consent, best-interest, and protection requirements.
A parent or legal representative may contact IMPAKT if they believe a child has provided data inappropriately.

sections.title: Legal basis and compliance principles
paragraphs: This policy follows principles of transparency, purpose limitation, data minimization, security, and respect for data-subject rights.
IMPAKT considers current Vietnamese personal-data-protection requirements, including Personal Data Protection Law No. 91/2025/QH15 and its implementing instruments.
bullets: Processing relies on consent where required by law.
Certain processing may be performed to fulfill a contract, legal duty, or another legally permitted basis.
The scope, purpose, and duration of processing are assessed in proportion to actual needs.

sections.title: Policy changes and contact information
paragraphs: IMPAKT may update this policy when the website, services, providers, or legal requirements change. The new version will be posted on this page with the updated date.
For significant changes, IMPAKT may provide an additional notice appropriate to the context and available contact information.
bullets: Ask a privacy-related question.
Request access, correction, deletion, or restriction of processing.
Report an incident or suspected inappropriate use of data.

final_note.title: Need an explanation or want to exercise a privacy right?
final_note.desc: Send your request with enough information for IMPAKT to verify and respond within an appropriate period.
